verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents an API and offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec for use 'with your own tooling'. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with try-it or runnable examples. The interactive demo is a product walkthrough, not an API explorer, and the downloadable spec is only a building block, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
